question: Can mixed native support first be re-expressed without changing protected imaging, then relinquish the proposal-facing part while retaining observed surfaces?
motivation: Depth-consistency qualification reaches only 2.8% of BUILD target crop contribution. Preserve the major mixed-support problem; do not widen thresholds or select an easier tiny subset.
frozen: original native temporal parameters and trajectories
full fixed lower domain and original protection references

stage0.scope: Audit full mixed UID coverage in target crop, full native foreground contribution and PVD visibility deficit before choosing an implementation subset
stage0.measurements: True BUILD LiDAR points in the a6 frame anchor the retained side; PVD independent proposal points define replacement-side requests; parent contribution associates observations, not semantic truth
stage0.plane: One persistent car-frame separator per mixed UID from retained-observation and proposal-responsibility centroids; no view-specific plane or post-hoc threshold sweep
stage0.clip_coverage: Report clipped/unclipped source contributions. Do not silently drop clipped parents and generalize an easy subset. Existing halfspaces must be included in moment calculations; old precision metadata cannot be copied to new centers/covariances.

stage1.action: Parent Gaussian -> two children for both separator sides; parent exits, neither child retires
stage1.moments: Conditional interval moments for untruncated parents; verified intersection moments for inherited clipped parents. Report probability, mean and covariance conservation against the correct clipped parent distribution.
stage1.opacity: Projected peak opacity is not 3D probability mass. q*sqrt(det(old covariance)/det(child covariance)) is an initialization, not a rendering conservation proof. No per-view normalization or silent opacity clipping to manufacture acceptance.
stage1.gate: Actual native-render RGB/alpha/depth and lower contribution must pass fixed preservation in BUILD and full49 states before any retirement arm
stage1.time: Children are deterministic derivatives of each prepared native parent at its true time, with shared car-frame separators and lineage. They are not yet immutable object assets; freezing temporal behavior requires a separate fit.

arms: S: R with replacement-side children retired 50%
U: R with both children retired at BUILD dose matched to S
stage2.quality: Retained child tails can still cross into replacement regions and vice versa; actual protected contributions and RGB/depth are required, not center labels alone
stage2.fallback: Saved parent state on any failed required gate

stop: If R cannot preserve imaging or S adds no safe benefit over U, stop zero-training scalar retirement and moment-only re-expression. Consider bounded local geometric/opacity refitting using raw object observations plus preservation constraints, with colors/PVD still frozen; keep this a separate method experiment.
scope_limits: Repeated scene mechanism frames are not independent generalization
No hidden texture or geometric accuracy claim from PVD contribution
